why: Signal is diffuse haze that tracks tissue density and stroma, with no distinct sparse population of membrane-stained cells.
notes: Yellow fills most of the tissue evenly and follows its outline and density. B and C show diffuse glow and no distinct stained cells. D shows blur, not membrane rings. No rare NK or CD8 subset is visible.
